_comment: OPT-IN example only. Do NOT copy into .claude/settings.json (that is the dev-session state hook). Enable the allow/deny gate with:  BUTTONLAB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765 BUTTONLAB_HOOK_TOKEN=<hook token from server startup> BUTTONLAB_BRIDGE_ID=<any id>  claude --settings hooks/hook-gate.settings.example.json .  The three BUTTONLAB_* values are read from the environment by hook_bridge.py so no secret is stored in this file. Status: code-integrated + unit-tested; submission-build E2E re-verification is a human step. The PTY key path (/api/press) is the sole E2E-verified submission path.
